description.en: Connects the memecub remote MCP server (5 tools: search_memes, get_meme, match_article, generate_meme, list_categories) and bundled Agent Skill to search Chinese and English reaction memes, place them into articles, or generate custom memes.
description.zh: 接入 memecub 远程 MCP 服务（5 个工具：search_memes / get_meme / match_article / generate_meme / list_categories）与内置 Agent Skill，在 DSH 中检索中英文表情包与梗图、自动给文章配图或用 AI 生成专属表情包。
